title: Generate release manifest and checksums
description: Create deterministic release metadata and checksums that bind the artifact to version, commit, architecture, and content digest.
acceptanceCriteria: Manifest includes semantic version, release tag, commit SHA, architecture, build/runtime versions, and artifact format
SHA-256 checksum is generated for the final artifact and all required files can be verified
Manifest contains no secret values, database contents, logs, or local paths that break reproducibility
A modified artifact or manifest fails verification

steps.details: Create a fixture with a known manifest and assert that changing a byte makes verification fail.
Generate deterministic JSON with sorted fields, explicit schema/version, and build metadata from CI environment or git.
Create a SHA-256 file using a stable filename and verify it with the target platform command.
Validate required fields, architecture, semver, and digest format before publication.
Run checksum mutation and valid-artifact tests and record output.

technicalNotes: Do not claim checksum integrity proves supply-chain provenance; GitHub attestation is a separate task.
